name: io.github.sapientsai/microsoft365-mcp-server
description: Microsoft 365 via Graph — mail, calendar, contacts, files, Teams, Planner, OneNote, To Do.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD application (client) ID. Every mode except client-token needs it.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Azure AD tenant ID, or 'common'/'organizations'/'consumers'. Read by certificate, client-secret and oauth-proxy modes.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the certificate used by certificate mode.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_CERT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the certificate at MS365_CERT_PATH, if it has one.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Graph access token supplied directly (client-token mode).

environmentVariables.name: MS365_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Auth mode: interactive (default), certificate, client-secret, client-token or oauth-proxy.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_OAUTH_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the OAuth proxy (oauth-proxy mode).

environmentVariables.name: MS365_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose read-only tools and refuse every write.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_ENABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against tool names; only matching tools are registered. Not a comma-separated list.

environmentVariables.name: MS365_PRESETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool presets to enable instead of naming tools individually.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Transport: 'stdio' (the default, and what this npm package is listed as) or 'httpStream' for remote/Docker deployments.
